_what: A four-station bench line, written for one job: to be small enough to commit and to script one of everything the labelled set has a word for.
_why: The set's fixture has to be a recorded run, not a hand-typed table, or it pins the shape of the file instead of the behaviour of the code. Four hundred seconds, four stations, and a scripted breakdown, changeover, micro-stop run, counter reset and disconnect - so every branch of the labelling has one example and nothing is left to a run nobody in this repository can reproduce.
_states: State column values: 0 stopped, 1 running, 2 starved, 3 blocked, 4 down, 5 changeover.
